description: Duplicate-run preflight false-positive class: a revisor pass that FILED a seed merges into the base branch referencing the seed id (e.g. bd41cbac filed fabro-58cb in PR #160), so the implementer preflight grep hits a commit that is NOT an implementation — naive 'any hit => Blocked' would dead-end every seed filed by a revisor. The rewritten implementer.md preflight (run 01M2MGAQ4TRWHGEY34P17K2R4D) tells the implementer to judge hits: only a merged IMPLEMENTATION is a duplicate. Future engine-side fixes (claim-race family) must encode the same distinction.
resolution: Preflight text now instructs judging each hit: a filing commit is not a duplicate; only a merged implementation routes Blocked.
